question:
**Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.**

The science of foretelling events by mapping stars
solution: The correct answer is: **Astrology**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given group of words refers to the practice of predicting events by studying the positions and movements of celestial objects, particularly stars. • The word that can substitute this group of words is "Astrology". • "**Astrology**" is a noun that refers to the study of the movements and relative positions of celestial objects as a means for divining information about human affairs and terrestrial events. (ज्योतिष शास्त्र) • The word "**astro**-" comes from the Greek word "**astron**", which means "**star**". • "**Astrology**" is often considered a pseudoscience, as its claims are not supported by empirical evidence. Thus, **option 3** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Astrophysics **refers to the branch of astronomy that deals with the physics of the universe, including the physical properties of celestial objects and the interstellar medium. (नक्षत्रीय भैतिकी जिसमें नक्षत्रों के भैतिक तत्‍वो का विश्‍लेषण होता है) • **Astronomy **refers to the scientific study of celestial objects and phenomena, including planets, stars, galaxies, and cosmic radiation. (खगोल-विज्ञान) • **Astrobiology **refers to the study of the origin, evolution, distribution, and future of life in the universe. (ब्रह्मांड में जीवन की उत्पत्ति, विकास, वितरण और भविष्य का अध्ययन) 1df:T4c0,The correct answer is: **won the vote**
